content: Sahabi okkolor ṭeng duwai diye

Uddar idor ekka gori age, Isa ei duniyaittu hibar Bafor hãse zaibar ṭaim aišše zaniyore, ei duniyait zara hibar nizor manuš aššil, zarare hibaye beši ador gorito, hitarare hibaye šeš foijjonto ador goijje.
Ar raitor hána haibar ṭaimot, hibare dorai dibolla šoitane Simonor fut Iskariyoti Ehudar dilot issa zuhai dil.
Isattu zana aššil ze, Bafe hár kissu hibar hatot diye, ar hiba Allar torfottu aišše, edde hiba Allar hãse firi zargoi;
toi hiba hánar ṭebilottu uiṭṭe, edde uworor hoorgan kulifelaiye, ar ekkan toila loiyore nizor kĩyailot beraiye.
Tarfore hibaye ek galat fani ḍaille edde hibar sahabi okkolor ṭeng duwai diya šuru goijje edde hibaye kĩyailot ze toila berail hiyan loi ṭeng fũsi diye.
Toi hiba Simon Fitoror ḍake zehon aišše, toi hite hodde, "Malik, õne ãre ṭeng duwai diba?"
Zuwabe Isaye hitare hodde,

content.text: "Ãi zin gorir hin tui ehon buzi no faror, kintu fore iyan buzi faribi."

content: Fitore hodde, "No, õne honodin ãr ṭeng no duiyo." Zuwabe Isaye hodde,

content.text: "Zodi tore ãi no dui, toile ãr loi tor hono bag nai."

content: Simon Fitore hibare hodde, "Malik, toile šude ãr ṭeng no, kintu ãr hat edde mata o dui do."
Isaye hitare hodde,

content.text: "Ze gusol goijje, ṭeng duwa sara hitattu ar hono kissur dorhar nai, hitar agagura foriškar, hite Pak fobitro. Ar tũwara Pak fobitro, kintu beggune no."

content: Kiyollahoile ze hibare dorai dibo hitare hibaye sinito, hetolla hibaye "tũwara beggune foriškar no" hen hoiyede.
Ar zehon hitarare ṭeng duwai diya šeš oiye, toi hibaye hor gat diye bade boišše. Toi hibaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Ãi tũwarare ki gorilam zano ne?
Tũwara ãre ustad, Malik, hoi ḍaki tako, ar gorode hiyan o bala, kiyollahoile ãi hen oi.
Bala, ãi malik edde ustad oi bade o tũwarar ṭeng duwai dilam, henot tũwara o ekzone ar ekzonore ṭeng duwai diya zoruri.
Kiyollahoile ãi tũwarare mesal dehailam, zene ãi tũwaralla zen goijji, tũwara o hendilla goro.
Ãi tũwarare soiyi soiyi hoir, gulam hitar nizor malikottuwaro boro no, ze defeṛaiye hibattuwaro zare defeṛa oiye hiba boro no.
Ehon, tũwara in okkol zano, ar hin okkol zodi goro, toile tũwarar mubarok.

content: Isaye dorai doyar babute hor

content.text: "Ãi tũwara beggunor hota no hoir; ãi hontarare ãlla basona goijji ãi zani. Kintu kitabor ei kalam furon owa forer: 'Ze ãr ruṭi hár, hite ãr berudde formuri tuille.'
"In goṭibar agottu ãi tũwarare hoi rakir, zene zẽtte in goṭibo hẽtte tũwara biššaš goro ze, ãi hiba.
Ãi tũwarare soiyi soiyi hoir, ãi zare defeṛai, hitare ze gose, hite ãre gose, ãre ze gose, hite hibare gose, ze ãre defeṛaiye."

content: Ei hota hoi bade Isar dilot hoisali oiye, ar goba diye,

content.text: "Ãi tũwarare soiyi soiyi hoir, tũwarar butottu ekzone ãre dorai dibo."

content: Sahabi okkole ekzone ar ekzonor uzu sa šuru goijje, ar ṭik buzi no faijjil hibaye har babute hoiyede.
Hetunot Isar sahabi okkolor butottu ekzon, zare Isaye muhabbot gorito, hite hibar kulot elan di boiššil.
Hetunot Simon Fitore išara goijjil edde hodde, "Hibaye zar babute hor, hiba honnuwa?"
Hetunot hite Isar mikka zúkdiyore hodde, "Malik, iba honnuwa?"
Isaye zuwab diye,

content.text: "Ei ruṭir ṭuragan buraiyore ãi zare diyum, iba oilde hite."

content: Toi hibaye ruṭir ṭuragan buraiyore Iskariyoti Simonor fut Ehudare diye.
Ehudaye ruṭir ṭuragan fai mottor Šoitan hitar butore góille. Isaye hitare hodde,

content.text: "Tui zin goribi hin toratori gor."

content: Hána haito boiššede hitarar honokiye buzi no fare hon bafe hibaye hitare iyan hoiye.
Ehudar hãse ṭiyar tolir zimma aššilde hetolla, kiye kiye mone goijje, Isaye hitare idolla zin zin lage kini angoi otóba gorib okkolore kissu dan goribolla hor.
Ruṭir ṭuragan loi mottor hite hehon baire giye. Ar hẽtte aššilde rait.
Isar noya hokum
Hite zaigoi bade, Isaye hodde,

content.text: "Ehon Adomor Fut mohimawala oiye, ar Allah hibar butore mohimawala oiye.
Allah zodi Adomor Futor butore mohimawala oiye, hetunot Allaye o hibare hibar nizor butore mohimawala goribo, ar hara hibare mohimawala goribo.
"Ãr fuwain okkol, ehon o olfo ṭaimolla, tũwarar fũwati ãi asi. Tũwara ãre tuwaiba, ar ãi Ihudi okkolore zen hoilam, hendilla tũwarare ãi ehon hoir: Ãi zeṛe zair, heṛe tũwara ai no fariba.
"Ek noya hokum ãi tũwarare dir: Tũwara ekzone ekzonore ador goro. Ãi zendilla tũwarare ador goijji, tũwara o hendilla ekzonore ekzone ador goro.
Tũwara zodi ekzonore ekzone ador goro, toile beggune zanibo ze tũwara ãr sahabi okkol."

content: Simon Fitore hibare hodde, "Malik, õne hoṛe zaibagoide?" Zuwabe Isaye hodde,

content.text: "Ãi zeṛe zair, heṛe tui ehon ãr fisa loi ai no faribi, kintu fore tui o heṛe aibi."

content: Fitore hodde, "Malik, ãi ehon kiyolla õnor fisa loi no fariyumde? Ãi õnolla ãr foran diyum."
Zuwabe Isaye hodde,

content.text: "Tui ki soiyi ãlla tor foran dibi? Ãi tore soiyi soiyi hoir, rata kuraye bak no dite, tui ãre tin bar ošikar goribi!
